attacks.reason: Shape-memory alloys may not be able to change shape in response to changes in blood temperature within the required time frame.

attacks.reason: The transfer of shape-memory alloy properties to a heart valve is not well-justified, as the mechanical and thermal properties of the alloy may not be suitable for a heart valve.
attacks.evidence_required: Theoretical or experimental data showing the mechanical and thermal properties of shape-memory alloys in a heart valve environment

attacks.reason: The SMA heart valve may fail at high blood flow rates or in the presence of blood clots.

attacks.reason: The combination of shape-memory alloys and heart valves is not an obvious one, as it requires a deep understanding of both materials science and cardiovascular engineering.

attacks.reason: Existing references disclose the use of shape-memory alloys in medical devices, including heart valves, which may render the invention obvious or anticipated.

attacks.reason: The integration of the SMA heart valve with the mechanical heart valve may be difficult to achieve, requiring significant engineering expertise and resources.
